classification.difficultyReason: Combine two conversion graphs through an intermediate currency.

content.prompt:
Use the two graphs below to find the exchange rate between British pounds and Japanese Yen.
Answer as an equation $\mathrm{JPY}=k\,\mathrm{GBP}$.

spec.description: GBP-to-USD graph, paired on the left of the USD-to-JPY graph. Source blue series retained using the standard blue palette.
spec.mathematics: Grid: GBP 0–40 in steps of 5; USD 0–60 in steps of 5. Labelled ticks every 10. The drawn line is consistent with USD approximately 1.3 GBP; this inferred coefficient requires independent review.
spec.answerVisibility: Axes, grid and supplied conversion line are permanent student givens.

spec.description: USD-to-JPY graph, paired on the right of the GBP-to-USD graph. Source blue series retained using the standard blue palette.
spec.mathematics: Grid: USD 0–40 in steps of 5; JPY 0–4500 in steps of 500. Horizontal labelled ticks every 10; vertical labelled ticks every 1000. The line passes through approximately (20,2500), consistent with JPY = 125 USD.
spec.answerVisibility: Axes, grid and supplied conversion line are permanent student givens.

answer.worked:
From the left graph, 20 GBP buys approximately 26 USD. From the right graph, 20 USD buys 2500 JPY.
$$\begin{align*}
\mathrm{USD}&\approx\frac{26}{20}\,\mathrm{GBP}\\
\mathrm{JPY}&=\frac{2500}{20}\,\mathrm{USD}\\
\mathrm{JPY}&\approx125\times1.3\,\mathrm{GBP}\\
\mathrm{JPY}&\approx162.5\,\mathrm{GBP}.
\end{align*}$$
